package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	StudentOnboardingDraftSchema           = "student-onboarding-draft.v1"
	StudentOnboardingFinalizeCommandSchema = "student-onboarding-finalize.v1"
	StudentOnboardingFinalizeResultSchema  = "student-onboarding-finalize-result.v1"
	TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema    = "teacher-student-onboarding-state.v1"
)

type StudentOnboardingDraftStatus string

const (
	StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft     StudentOnboardingDraftStatus = "DRAFT"
	StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted StudentOnboardingDraftStatus = "COMPLETED"
)

// StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers contains only the eventual StudentOnboarding
// fields. Nil means unanswered; a non-nil pointer means explicitly answered.
type StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers struct {
	DirectionCode          *string   `json:"direction_code,omitempty"`
	SelfAssessedExperience *string   `json:"self_assessed_experience,omitempty"`
	KnownStacks            *[]string `json:"known_stacks,omitempty"`
	DesiredStacks          *[]string `json:"desired_stacks,omitempty"`
	GoalCode               *string   `json:"goal_code,omitempty"`
	GoalText               *string   `json:"goal_text,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage      *string   `json:"preferred_language,omitempty"`
	WeeklyMinutes          *int      `json:"weekly_minutes,omitempty"`
	PreferredPace          *string   `json:"preferred_pace,omitempty"`
}

type StudentOnboardingDraft struct {
	Schema    string                       `json:"schema"`
	StudentID string                       `json:"student_id"`
	Status    StudentOnboardingDraftStatus `json:"status"`
	StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
	Version                 int64      `json:"version"`
	CompletedProfileVersion *int64     `json:"completed_profile_version,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt               *time.Time `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt               *time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
	CompletedAt             *time.Time `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult struct {
	Schema  string                 `json:"schema"`
	Draft   StudentOnboardingDraft `json:"draft"`
	Profile StudentOnboarding      `json:"profile"`
}

// TeacherStudentOnboardingState contains only the draft command preconditions
// required by trusted Teacher orchestration. ProfileVersion is the current
// optimistic student_onboarding version, or zero when no profile exists.
type TeacherStudentOnboardingState struct {
	Schema         string                 `json:"schema"`
	Draft          StudentOnboardingDraft `json:"draft"`
	ProfileVersion int64                  `json:"profile_version"`
}

func NewTeacherStudentOnboardingState(
	draft StudentOnboardingDraft,
	profileVersion int64,
) (TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(draft)
	if err != nil || profileVersion < 0 ||
		(normalized.Status == StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted &&
			(normalized.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || profileVersion < *normalized.CompletedProfileVersion)) {
		return TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, errors.New("invalid teacher student onboarding state")
	}
	return TeacherStudentOnboardingState{
		Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, Draft: normalized, ProfileVersion: profileVersion,
	}, nil
}

func EmptyStudentOnboardingDraft(studentID string) (StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	return NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: studentID,
		Status: StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: 0,
	})
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(input StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) (StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers, error) {
	var result StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
	var err error
	if result.DirectionCode, err = normalizeDraftCode(input.DirectionCode); err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, err
	}
	if result.SelfAssessedExperience, err = normalizeDraftCode(input.SelfAssessedExperience); err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, err
	}
	if result.GoalCode, err = normalizeDraftCode(input.GoalCode); err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, err
	}
	if result.PreferredPace, err = normalizeDraftCode(input.PreferredPace); err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, err
	}
	if input.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		value := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(*input.PreferredLanguage))
		if !validLanguageCode(value) {
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft language")
		}
		result.PreferredLanguage = &value
	}
	if input.GoalText != nil {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(*input.GoalText)
		if !utf8.ValidString(value) || utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > 500 {
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft goal text")
		}
		result.GoalText = &value
	}
	if input.WeeklyMinutes != nil {
		value := *input.WeeklyMinutes
		if value < 15 || value > 10080 {
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft weekly minutes")
		}
		result.WeeklyMinutes = &value
	}
	if input.KnownStacks != nil {
		values, normalizeErr := normalizeOnboardingValues(*input.KnownStacks)
		if normalizeErr != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, normalizeErr
		}
		result.KnownStacks = &values
	}
	if input.DesiredStacks != nil {
		values, normalizeErr := normalizeOnboardingValues(*input.DesiredStacks)
		if normalizeErr != nil || len(values) == 0 {
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft desired stacks")
		}
		result.DesiredStacks = &values
	}
	return result, nil
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(input StudentOnboardingDraft) (StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if input.Schema != StudentOnboardingDraftSchema {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft schema")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft student")
	}
	answers, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(input.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, err
	}
	input.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers = answers
	input.CreatedAt = utcDraftTime(input.CreatedAt)
	input.UpdatedAt = utcDraftTime(input.UpdatedAt)
	input.CompletedAt = utcDraftTime(input.CompletedAt)
	input.CompletedProfileVersion = copyDraftInt64(input.CompletedProfileVersion)

	if input.Version == 0 {
		if input.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft || hasDraftAnswers(answers) ||
			input.CreatedAt != nil || input.UpdatedAt != nil || input.CompletedAt != nil || input.CompletedProfileVersion != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid empty onboarding draft")
		}
		return input, nil
	}
	if input.Version < 1 || input.CreatedAt == nil || input.UpdatedAt == nil || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(*input.CreatedAt) {
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid persisted onboarding draft")
	}
	switch input.Status {
	case StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft:
		if input.CompletedAt != nil || input.CompletedProfileVersion != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid active onboarding draft")
		}
	case StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted:
		if hasDraftAnswers(answers) || input.CompletedAt == nil || input.CompletedAt.Before(*input.CreatedAt) ||
			input.CompletedAt.After(*input.UpdatedAt) || input.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || *input.CompletedProfileVersion < 1 {
			return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid completed onboarding draft")
		}
	default:
		return StudentOnboardingDraft{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft status")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func BuildStudentOnboardingFromDraft(
	draft StudentOnboardingDraft,
	profileVersion int64,
	profileCreatedAt time.Time,
	profileUpdatedAt time.Time,
) (StudentOnboarding, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(draft)
	if err != nil || normalized.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft || normalized.Version < 1 ||
		normalized.DirectionCode == nil || normalized.SelfAssessedExperience == nil || normalized.DesiredStacks == nil ||
		normalized.GoalCode == nil || normalized.PreferredLanguage == nil || normalized.WeeklyMinutes == nil ||
		normalized.PreferredPace == nil || profileVersion < 1 {
		return StudentOnboarding{}, errors.New("incomplete onboarding draft")
	}
	knownStacks := []string{}
	if normalized.KnownStacks != nil {
		knownStacks = append([]string(nil), (*normalized.KnownStacks)...)
	}
	goalText := ""
	if normalized.GoalText != nil {
		goalText = *normalized.GoalText
	}
	return NormalizeStudentOnboarding(StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID: normalized.StudentID, DirectionCode: *normalized.DirectionCode,
		SelfAssessedExperience: *normalized.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks:            knownStacks, DesiredStacks: append([]string(nil), (*normalized.DesiredStacks)...),
		GoalCode: *normalized.GoalCode, GoalText: goalText, PreferredLanguage: *normalized.PreferredLanguage,
		WeeklyMinutes: *normalized.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: *normalized.PreferredPace,
		ProfileVersion: StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: profileVersion,
		CreatedAt: profileCreatedAt, UpdatedAt: profileUpdatedAt,
	})
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboardingFinalizeResult(input StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult) (StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	if input.Schema != StudentOnboardingFinalizeResultSchema {
		return StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding finalize result schema")
	}
	draft, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(input.Draft)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, err
	}
	profile, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(input.Profile)
	if err != nil || draft.Status != StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted || draft.StudentID != profile.StudentID ||
		draft.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || *draft.CompletedProfileVersion != profile.Version {
		return StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding finalize result")
	}
	input.Draft, input.Profile = draft, profile
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeDraftCode(input *string) (*string, error) {
	if input == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	value := normalizeOnboardingCode(*input)
	if !onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(value) {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid onboarding draft code")
	}
	return &value, nil
}

func hasDraftAnswers(input StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers) bool {
	return input.DirectionCode != nil || input.SelfAssessedExperience != nil || input.KnownStacks != nil ||
		input.DesiredStacks != nil || input.GoalCode != nil || input.GoalText != nil ||
		input.PreferredLanguage != nil || input.WeeklyMinutes != nil || input.PreferredPace != nil
}

func utcDraftTime(input *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if input == nil {
		return nil
	}
	value := input.UTC()
	return &value
}

func copyDraftInt64(input *int64) *int64 {
	if input == nil {
		return nil
	}
	value := *input
	return &value
}
